unit.why: A brief memorate: the narrator saw the Berdichever rabbi hold a candle and burn himself, which is a witnessed event and not a saying.
unit.boundary_note: One of a numbered series of reports by the same narrator ('עוד סיפר הרה"ק הנ"ל'); self-contained.

stories.start_quote: עוד סיפר הרה"ק הנ"ל שראה הרב מבא"ד
stories.summary_en: The holy rabbi related that he saw the rabbi of Berdichev hold a candle and inflict burns on himself.

quotes: שאחז נר והי׳ עושה בעצמו מכוות אש

tags.why: Framed as an eyewitness report told by a named tsaddik in a series.
The anecdote illustrates the tsaddik's extreme piety and self-denial.
